conventions.numbers: inputs are decimal or p/q STRINGS read exactly; exact values are written "p/q" or "p"; a value is exact {u, v, b} meaning u + v*sqrt(b), b square-free (b = 1: rational), approx (the exact form of a root of a number containing a radical is not attempted) or undefined
conventions.rules: line a*x | stretch a*x^2 | shift (x - a)^2 | root sqrt(x + a) | pole 1/(x - a) | abs |x - a|; catalogue lin 2x - 1 | sq x^2 | rt sqrt(x) | rec 1/x
conventions.domain: all | {except, point} | {ray, side: above, bound: {at, closed}} (read off a grid of eighths in [-12, 12], the edge located by bisection)
conventions.preimages: count and roots (doubles, 9 decimals) of f(x) = h found by scanning eighths in [-40, 40]; count 'all' when f is constantly h
conventions.properties: injective: never more than one preimage and onto: always at least one, over the 19 heights of the preimage table
conventions.inverses: roundTrip: g(f(x)) = x exactly with g the formula inverse (sq only when restricted to x >= 0); twin: the other input with the same output (sq, unrestricted)

tolerance.unit: absolute, on the decimal approximation of an irrational value, and on the roots found by bisection
tolerance.rationale: the TypeScript evaluates u + v*sqrt(b) in doubles (|value| <= ~100); the oracle evaluates the same function to 60 digits and rounds once. Exact values, undefined / defined, domains, preimage counts, injective and onto must match EXACTLY.
